messages.author: 9c2d7dc849a61d95
messages.subject: write.cross for 4way cross
parts:
Hi, 

I used JoinMap files (.loc, .qua, and .map) as input files to r/qtl to QTL analysis for 4way cross.
I tried to save the resulted cross file using write.cross function, but it works only for intercross, backcross, RI, double haploid, and haploid data. 
Can anyone suggest a way to save my  cross file.
This is the code I used.

# inputing the data generated from JoinMap 

x= read.cross("mapqtl", genfile="Genotypes.loc", phefile="Phenotypes.qua", mapfile="Map.map")


#save x

#write.cross(x,format = "csv",filestem = "Ris_Cabmap")


Thank you, 
Dilmini

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] write.cross for 4way cross
parts:
There's not currently a way to export 4-way cross data.
But you already have it in the .loc, .qua, and .map files.

karl
